title: CLAIM_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE fails with CLAIM_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE_LINE_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose CLAIM_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (line_full). The claimant's NRV trustline is at its limit of 1; the balance holds 5.

hazards.placement: claim into a trustline at its limit

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
